jobs.title: Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) — Apply Online for Common Recruitment Process under CRP-RRBs-XV
jobs.details: IBPS opened online registration for the Common Recruitment Process for Regional Rural Banks (CRP RRBs XV) on 01.09.2026, closing on 21.09.2026, for Group "A" Officers (Scale-I, II & III) and Group "B" Office Assistants (Multipurpose). A candidate may apply for Office Assistants and for any one Officers post, but has to apply and pay separately for each. Officer Scale-I and Office Assistants take a Preliminary and a Main online examination; Officers Scale-II and Scale-III take a single online examination. Pre-Exam Training and the Preliminary examination are tentatively in November 2026 and November / December 2026, the Main / Single examination in December 2026 to February 2027, the Officers' interview in January / February 2027 coordinated by the nodal Regional Rural Banks with NABARD, and provisional allotment in February / March 2027. The edit window for correcting the form runs for two days after registration closes. Indicative vacancies are state-wise in Annexure I of the notification. Queries and complaints: https://cgrs.ibps.in. For Office Assistants and Officer Scale-I the test versions offered for Punjab are English, Hindi and Punjabi, and the medium is chosen in the online application. Office Assistants (Multipurpose) in Group "B": two-tier selection — Online Preliminary Examination (Reasoning, Computer Knowledge, General Awareness, English/Hindi, Numerical Ability) and Online Main Examination of 200 marks; provisional allotment is made by the RRB of the State/UT applied for on the basis of Main marks and the vacancies it reports.
